body: v0.10.53 is cut on 9fff3bd78 (PR #594, task 6fe2f5a2: effort is settable per session role on a node with h9k config set --effort-build through --effort-courier, plus a project and a task effort; a session resolves task, then project, then node role, then node-wide, then the model's default). All five release assets are published. Please run h9k update --restart at a lull (no gate or merge in flight) and reply with the status line and daemon pid. Nothing further is queued for hall9k after this one.
